design.question: Does an original frozen 21-parameter learned signed-binding mechanism transfer to an independently generated, identity-disjoint 7-9-hop composition distribution more robustly than the fixed public approximate baseline?
novelty: reused opaque role labels at nonadjacent hops
partially observed distractor edge token features
token and topology histogram identical across each positive-negative pair
labels determined by exact public causal traversal; no symbolic/label/path input to learned forward
design.study: Retest original B on genuine new source using a read-only one-reference input-validator clone; frozen weights and threshold 0.5; separate FIT and DEV cohorts source-disjoint. A follow-up new learned mechanism needs its own preimplementation freeze and train-only workflow; this study does not claim such a new mechanism.
design.criterion: Report complete paired DEV denominator, per depth, raw work counters, and any model-budget exceptions. Infer superior generalization only after independent original first-use with matched measured compute; this gate is development evidence only. Retain negative/neutral outcome.
